playbook: the article editor is https://editor.csdn.net/md/ (Markdown): ONE action=publish with title=, body= in Markdown (## headings, a blank line between paragraphs) and files=[pictures]; publish writes the Markdown, pastes each picture (CSDN uploads it and inserts its link; each takes several seconds) and opens the 发布文章 panel
the title is the input at the top (placeholder 请输入文章标题（5～100个字）); a title shorter than 5 characters is refused by CSDN
after a failed publish call the page is /md?articleId=N (a saved draft): call publish again on that same page, never open a second editor
